method.tool: search/C2/S1..S8*.json from coverage_search.py --regex --whole-words (terms.txt) plus recgrep.py; record front matter read for every cell via idx.py/show.py; vendored lines read in context with gg.py; mapping checked against cic/corpus-map via wf.py; quotes verified with verify.py (+ verify2.py for four false mismatches).
method.layers: RENDERED = a record speaks to it (partial=true marks R*: a guard, a not_for, or one facet only); LOADED = vendored and mapped to the world, read in context, no record; IDENTIFIED = registered unvendored / in cross-world queue; OTHER = outside the repo, from working knowledge, not fetched; NOTHING.
